main_text.l: Ēnsor meorum carminum Vtenhoui, meos Commendo fratres hos tibi; Fratres quidē fraterrimos: hoc est, malos, Crassos, ineptos, garrulos.
Tu necte, plecte, cæde, fac gemant suis Variata terga funibus.
Sin pectus illis non sit insanabile, Medentis vt ferant manum:
Vnus mederi poteris, artes cui suas Indulsit vni Delius,
Sic vt profunda conditum caligine, Ab vsque lethæis vadis
Nonnum euocaris, grauiter iratis sua Parcis retexi stamina:
Et ius Latinæ ciuitatis & togæ Refuscitato indulseris:
Et qui latebat ante squallidus situ,

page.notes: The initial letter E is a large woodcut initial, transcribed as "Ēnsor" with the initial joined to the word. Signature "A. ij." printed at lower right. Library stamps and a marginal ink mark on the right were not transcribed. Some letters in the first line are uncertain: "Ēnsor" may read "Ensor"; "Vtenhoui" is as printed.
